text.answer: Sylas is a mage and assassin with an AP focus and magic damage. He combines spells with empowered attacks, heals through champion combat, and copies enemy ultimates. Counterplay: keep your distance, dodge his chains, and account for the ultimate he has copied.

text.counterplay: Dodge the chains and move away from their intersection.

text.counterplay: Respect his healing when chasing him at low health.

text.answer: Abscond / Abduct: Sylas dashes to a location, then can briefly recast to throw his chains. The chains deal magic damage, reveal and stun the first enemy hit, then pull Sylas to them for a knock-up.
text.counterplay: Prepare to dodge the chain after his dash; use minions as cover.

text.answer: Hijack: Sylas copies an enemy champion's ultimate and briefly reveals them. He can hold the copy temporarily and recast to use it at no cost, but cannot copy the same champion again for a while. Copied abilities without AP scaling have their AD ratios converted to AP ratios.
text.counterplay: Account for the copied ultimate when choosing your position and timing an engage.
